headline: Apple beats quarterly revenue expectations
body: Apple reported quarterly revenue of $123B, above Wall Street estimates of $118B. However iPhone sales in China declined 15% year over year amid competition.

headline: S&P 500 rises on strong tech earnings
body: The S&P 500 gained 1.2% as mega-cap tech names posted better than expected earnings. Volatility remained subdued.

headline: Gold falls as dollar strengthens
body: Gold prices dropped 0.8% after the US dollar index rose. Traders cut safe-haven demand ahead of the Fed meeting.

headline: EURUSD weakens on ECB dovish comments
body: EURUSD declined 0.5% after ECB officials signaled patience on rate cuts. Euro area growth data missed forecasts.

headline: US30 drops amid growth concerns
body: The Dow Jones fell 2.1% as manufacturing data missed expectations. Risk-off sentiment spread across indices.
